general.describe: Before you argue about self-hosting a model for your coding agents, read your own logs. Claude Code keeps a JSONL transcript of every model call under ~/.claude/projects , token usage included. We took one developer's transcripts from 21 September to 20 October: 129,407 calls and 26.2 billion tokens (tokens are the word fragments a model reads and bills by). Priced three ways, that month is 400 dollars on the two Claude Max 20x subscriptions he pays, 12,365 dollars at Claude API list price, and 274 dollars on DeepSeek's API. general.describe: If you build a WhatsApp product for other businesses, every customer's events arrive at the same place: one Meta app has one webhook callback URL and one app secret, so all of your tenants share an endpoint. Multi-tenancy is something you add on your side. Resolve the tenant from the IDs Meta sends, metadata.phone_number_id first and the WABA ID in entry[].id when that's all there is.
